title.value: "It was 80% me, 20% AI": Seeking Authenticity in Co-Writing with Large Language Models
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the document, specifying the focus on authenticity in co-writing with large language models.
title.quote: "It was 80% me, 20% AI": Seeking Authenticity in Co-Writing with Large Language Models

analysis.description: This paper studies the impact of large language models (LLMs) on writing authenticity, exploring how both writers and readers perceive such tools. It conducts interviews with writers and surveys with readers to understand preferences for personalized and non-personalized AI writing assistance and its effect on authenticity in creative work.

type.justification: The paper conducts semi-structured interviews with writers and surveys with readers to gather empirical data regarding their experiences and perceptions of authenticity in AI co-writing.
type.quote: We conducted semi-structured interviews... and supplemented writers’ perspectives with opinions from... an online survey.

name.justification: The paper focuses on the human-centered computing field, exploring the interaction between writers, readers, and AI writing tools.
